title: Formulary Benefit Desk Card: Retail Transition Supply
content:
**What it is.** Under the Formulary Benefit, a retail transition supply is the temporary supply of a non-formulary drug that a network retail pharmacy dispenses to a member inside the member's transition window. Its days supply is worked out from the member's records.

**When the days supply is fixed.** A retail transition supply's days supply is fixed only after the records carry, for every non-formulary drug whose specialty shipments to the member were still running on the transition start date, a specialty transition supply dated inside the current transition window.

In other words, the days supply of the retail supply is settled only once the transition-fill history shows that state. For each non-formulary drug whose specialty shipments to the member were still running on the transition start date, there must be a specialty transition supply dated on or after that start date.

## Recording tool: `record_retail_transition_supply_5b1515b2`

**Capability.** One call adds one transition fill to the member's transition-fill history under the formulary assignment. The fill is dated today, carries the retail dispensing channel and the days supply given, and the member's pharmacy can then dispense that many days. The fill appears whenever the member's transition fills are looked up. The tool makes this one write and checks nothing about eligibility or the value.

**Invocation.** This is an agent-side tool. The agent unlocks `record_retail_transition_supply_5b1515b2` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `formulary_assignment_id` | reference number of the member's formulary assignment, as read from the formulary assignment lookup for the member | identifier |
| `drug_name` | the drug | exactly one drug master list name: atorvastatin, lisinopril, metformin, sertraline, levothyroxine, sumatriptan, oxycodone-acetaminophen, insulin glargine-yfgn, Lantus, Eliquis, Xarelto, Jardiance, Ozempic, Mounjaro, Wegovy, Zepbound, Trelegy Ellipta, Breztri Aerosphere, Nurtec ODT, Ubrelvy, Humira, adalimumab-adaz, Dupixent, Skyrizi, Rinvoq, Enbrel, Biktarvy, Ibrance |
| `drug_strength` | the strength and dosage form, copied character for character from the strength shown on the member's latest paid retail fill of the drug | verbatim text, with no change to wording, digits or punctuation |
| `transition_basis` | why the member is in a transition window: `new_enrollment` (the assignment has no formulary change date, so the window runs from the coverage effective date) or `formulary_change` (the assignment carries a formulary change date because the sponsor moved the member to this formulary) | enum |
| `days_supply` | the days supply dispensed | whole number of days, no decimals; stored exactly as given |

A parameter's presence means only that the value must be supplied when the call is made.

**Return.** The receipt carries:
- `formulary_transition_fill_id`, the new transition fill's reference number;
- `drug_name`;
- `fill_date`, today as YYYY-MM-DD;
- `days_supply`, a whole number;
- `dispensing_channel`, which is always retail for this tool;
- status "recorded".

Status "recorded" means the supply was recorded. No other outcome is defined for this tool.
